name: sofagent-monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=engine/harness && npm run build --workspace=engine/ontology && npm run build --workspace=engine/core && npm run build --workspace=engine/rules && npm run build --workspace=engine/think && npm run build --workspace=engine/audit && npm run build --workspace=engine/eval && npm run build --workspace=engine/skillopt && npm run build --workspace=engine/orchestrator && npm run build --workspace=engine/daemon && npm run build --workspace=engine/ab-test && npm run build --workspace=engine/mcp && npm run build --workspace=engine/hooks/sofagent-load-chain

//optionalDependencies: F-18 归属说明：@langchain/anthropic 是 root 级可选依赖，对应编排层 LLM 厂商运行时可选适配器——orchestrator/ab-test 经 @langchain/langgraph 的 createReactAgent（launcher.ts/ab-runner.ts 动态 import）按模型厂商动态加载 ChatAnthropic。源码无静态 import（grep engine/*/src 零命中），仅运行时按需解析；作为 optionalDependency，其安装失败不阻断 build/test，audit 核心引擎零依赖。v1.2.1 (commit 295bf26) 加入。结论：保留并在此注明用途，勿删（删之会破坏运行时 Anthropic 模型动态加载）。
